series.name: Tiny Desk Concerts
series.convention: stripped-down, behind a desk in a small office

series.name: Tiny Desk Home Concerts
series.convention: filmed at home or on location, often a fuller band

series.name: Live on KEXP
series.convention: full band live in a radio studio, loud and raw

series.name: KEXP at Home
series.title_rule: {artist} - Full Performance (Live on KEXP at Home)
series.convention: full band recorded remotely in the artist's own space

series.name: A COLORS SHOW
series.convention: one voice and a beat, one song, minimal colored backdrop

series.name: A COLORS ENCORE
series.convention: a second song after a COLORS SHOW, same minimal setup
